claims.statement: Francesco left property to Leonardo; Leonardo's half brothers contested it. Charles d'Amboise and Louis XII wrote to the Florentine government on Leonardo's behalf in 1507, and a draft of Leonardo's letter on the quarrel with his brothers (c.1508) survives in the Codex Atlanticus.
